title: Maiden Tower
visualBrief: Baku limestone tower with its asymmetric seaside buttress, rounded nose, relief masonry bands, recessed slit openings and open roof parapet.

nativeAxes.front: OSM-local +X points approximately east; western doorway toward -X
nativeAxes.origin: Minimum-area OSM footprint center in X/Z; nominal lowest exterior base at Y=0

scaleBasis: Reserve administration cylinder diameter and height envelope; Presidential Library entrance and panel dimensions; OSM asymmetric buttress footprint. Nominal 31 m base-to-parapet includes the reported 3 m site-level difference.

geographicProposal.evidence: Exact Q842822 asymmetric outline establishes the directed east/southeast buttress, overcoming the rectangle axis ambiguity; model preserves the mapped cylinder offset.
geographicProposal.limitations: Ground varies by 3 m. Terrain contact is provisional; slope, foundation rock and adjoining low structures need site review.
geographicProposal.notes: Exact Q842822 asymmetric outline establishes the directed east/southeast buttress, overcoming the rectangle axis ambiguity; model preserves the mapped cylinder offset. Ground varies by 3 m. Terrain contact is provisional; slope, foundation rock and adjoining low structures need site review.

geometrySource: Original deterministic geometry informed by cited dimensions, measured plans and photographs. No downloaded mesh or photographic texture is embedded.
sourceLicense: Original geometry under repository license. Map-derived outline information is attributed to OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL-1.0. Reference publications retain their own rights.
materialMethod: Shared material graphs with metric repeat UV0 and original vertex tints; GLB PBR fallback remains self-contained. No per-model texture duplication.
limitations: Rib count, slit positions and buttress nose curvature are estimates from the library exterior photograph and OSM, not measured conservation geometry.
Interior museum floors, the well, adjoining lower defensive buildings, inscriptions and individual damaged blocks are not reconstructed.
A uniform Y=0 base requires terrain fitting to the sloping rock. Exterior dimensions do not establish a surveyed vertical datum.
Near/far visual QA, shared-material inspection and maximum-fidelity approval remain pending.
